speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The sword stays on the nail. School is not a tiring-house, and the lane is not a stage.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Tomorrow the master lets me off. Grandfather said. Today I only wanted the hilt as far as the corner, and then back.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: Tomorrow morning, and not the sword. I have spoken to the master. Today thou declines hic, haec, hoc like a Christian, and the nail does the keeping.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: If the sword stays, the ribbons stay. That is the same rule on a second nail. I am not negotiating with a ribbon.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Thou art not taking a wooden sword to the school lane, Hamnet. I have brushed one cloak. I will not brush a battle.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: You said tomorrow, grandfather. You did not say the morning includes the nail. Which of the two is the promise.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: The morning is the promise. The nail is today. A house may hold two facts if someone will let them sit apart.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The nail today. Tomorrow, if thy mother allows a street and not a school, the sword may go as far as she says, and no farther. Thou art back at eleven.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Eleven, and the pottage is not a prize for Latin. Eat before you go. Will, thou art in the doorway again.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Eleven is a number I can keep. The corner was a poorer bargain, and I am leaving it.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: He is leaving it because it was refused, not because it was poor. I want the record straight before the bread is gone.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: The record is the nail. Sit, Judith, and do not plead a ribbon into a right.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was only going to say how I would tie the cord on the shop bundle. Richard has the door, and the cord is —

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Then do not say it. If Richard has the door, Richard has the cord. Bread, brother.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: I taught thee to cut a glove, Will, not to narrate a knot from the threshold. Richard is already about it.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: So tomorrow morning is the leave, today is the nail, and eleven is when Hamnet is back. Three facts. Nobody has mixed them except at the start.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Then they can stay unmixed. The three of you, bread, and out. The sword does not attend.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: I can see it from the bench. That will do until tomorrow. I am not touching the nail.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: I am not touching the ribbon either. A rule that is only for him is not a rule. Mine is kept.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Kept, then. I have no improvement to offer the cord, Joan. I unsay it.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Unsaying is the useful part. Eat. The master will not take a speech in place of a boy.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: Off with you. Tomorrow I have said, and I do not mean the afternoon, and I do not mean the sword in a form.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Cloaks. I have brushed his. Judith, thine is on the chest, and it is a cloak, not a part.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: I have the bread. Nobody needs to describe it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Bread, then. Eleven is the bargain, and the nail holds the rest.
